page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic words mixed into the Latin lexicon entries; a running head at the top; page number 339 at the top left; signature "Vu 2" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: târunt, Psal.78.56. Part.cum ה characteristico, מהנסי Tentans, Genes.22.1. in Targ. Hierof. Imperat. Syr. ‏ܘܣܦܬ Vosipsos probate, 2. ad Corinth. 13.5. Regia, Curate, quasi ab אמי effet. Ithpah. אתנסי, Syr. ܢܣܝܬ Tentari, probari.
נסיתא Ch. Tentatio: experientia: Item proprium nomen loci, Hebr. מסה, ubi Israelitæ Dominum tentârunt, Exod.17.7.
נסא Ch. Experientia, 1.Sam.17.39. Item Tentatio, Probatio, Plur. נסין Tentationes, Exo.15.25. in T.Hierof.
נסיון, נסיונא, נסיון, Ch. ܢܣܝܘܢܐ Syr. Tentatio, probatio, periculū, experientia. Plur. נסיונין, ܢܣܝܘܢܐ. Vide & infrà in נסס.
ܡܢܣܝܢ Syr. Tentator, 1.ad Thess.3.5. Alias etiam ܡܢܣܝܢ Participialiter, Matth.4.3.
נסח Ch. Amovere, avellere, evellere, exstirpare, ut Hebr. Pahel נסח Idem: Ithpehal Futur: יתנסח Avellatur, Esr.6.11. Esth.7.9.
נסך Ch. Fundere, effundere, perfundere, libare. Pahel נסך Idem. Ithpahel אתנסך Libari.
נסכא, נסך Ch. Fusio: Libamen. Plur. נסכין, נסכי.
נסס Ch. Turbari, conturbari, perturbari, dolore affici. Ithpeh. אתנסס, & אתנסים Idem. Pahel נסס Turbare, conturbari, perturbare.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic vocalised forms are copied as far as legible; the heavily pointed and superscript Syriac forms on lines of the entries are uncertain and may differ in detail from the printed type.
